```{python}
#| label: ego-extract
def csp_ego_graph(edges_df, nodes_df, k=18):
    """Extract CSP1-2 + top k co-occurring genera by edge weight."""
    # CSP1-2 might appear as "CSP1-2" or similar - find its exact name
    csp_names = [n for n in pd.unique(edges_df[["source","target"]].values.ravel())
                 if isinstance(n, str) and ("CSP1-2" in n or "Dadabacteria" in n)]
    if not csp_names:
        return None
    csp = csp_names[0]
    # Get edges incident to CSP
    inc = edges_df[(edges_df.source == csp) | (edges_df.target == csp)].copy()
    inc["partner"] = inc.apply(lambda r: r.target if r.source == csp else r.source, axis=1)
    # Take top by |weight|
    inc = inc.sort_values("weight", key=lambda s: s.abs(), ascending=False).head(k)
    # Build graph on CSP + partners
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_node(csp, is_csp=True)
    for _, r in inc.iterrows():
        G.add_node(r.partner, is_csp=False)
        G.add_edge(csp, r.partner, weight=r.weight, sign=r.sign)
    return G, csp

def plot_ego(G, csp, ax, title):
    pos = nx.spring_layout(G, k=0.8, iterations=60, seed=42)
    # Edges: width by |weight|, color by sign
    for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True):
        w = abs(d["weight"])
        c = "#b91c1c" if d["sign"] < 0 else "#1d4ed8"
        ax.plot([pos[u][0], pos[v][0]], [pos[u][1], pos[v][1]],
                color=c, lw=0.8 + 4 * w, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
    for node, p in pos.items():
        is_csp = node == csp
        ax.scatter(p[0], p[1], s=550 if is_csp else 90,
                   c="#d97706" if is_csp else "#6b7280",
                   edgecolor="k", linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)
        lab = "CSP1-2" if is_csp else node.split("_")[0][:14]
        ax.annotate(lab, (p[0], p[1]), fontsize=7 if not is_csp else 9,
                    fontweight="bold" if is_csp else "normal",
                    ha="center", va="center",
                    xytext=(0, 0), textcoords="offset points", zorder=4)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.spines[:].set_visible(False)

egos = {}
for comp in ["surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"]:
    egos[comp] = csp_ego_graph(edges[comp], nodes[comp], k=14)
    print(f"{comp}: {egos[comp][0].number_of_nodes() if egos[comp] else None} nodes")
```

```{python}
#| label: figure
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
gs = GridSpec(2, 3, figure=fig,
              height_ratios=[1.0, 1.0],
              width_ratios=[1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
              hspace=0.32, wspace=0.30)

# -- Row 1: three ego networks per compartment --
for i, comp in enumerate(["surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"]):
    ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, i])
    if egos[comp]:
        G, csp = egos[comp]
        plot_ego(G, csp, ax, f"({'abc'[i]}) {comp.capitalize()} — CSP1-2 ego network (14 co-occurring genera)")
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f"{comp}: CSP1-2 not a network node", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
        ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])

# (signature pathway heatmap moved to Supplementary Figure S32)

# -- Row 3: Cross-desert (prevalence + 2 scatters) --
ax_f = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
desert_order = ["EmptyQuarter", "Namib", "McMurdo", "Atacama"]
desert_labels = ["Empty Q", "Namib", "McMurdo", "Atacama"]
prev = cd_summary.set_index("desert").reindex(desert_order)["frac_samples_with_CSP85"].astype(float).values
desert_colors = ["#444", "#d97706", "#0e7490", "#b91c1c"]
bars = ax_f.bar(range(4), prev, color=desert_colors, edgecolor="k", alpha=0.8)
for i, v in enumerate(prev):
    if not np.isnan(v):
        ax_f.text(i, v + 0.02, f"{v*100:.0f}%", ha="center", fontweight="bold", fontsize=9)
ax_f.set_xticks(range(4)); ax_f.set_xticklabels(desert_labels)
ax_f.set_ylabel("Fraction of samples with CSP1-2")
ax_f.set_title("(d) Cross-desert prevalence of CSP1-2 at 85% V4 ID", loc="left", fontsize=10)
ax_f.set_ylim(0, 1.05)
ax_f.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax_f.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)

from scipy.stats import linregress, spearmanr

# Load EQ per-sample CSP1-2 × Shannon × salinity (Trip 5 only)
eq_sal = pd.read_csv("../data/csp_mags/eq_sample_csp_shannon_salinity.tsv", sep="\t")

# (g) CSP1-2 abundance → Shannon — EQ + Namib overlaid
ax_g = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
# EQ: per-sample, use Trip 5 for completeness; csp_rel is fractional
eq_csp = eq_sal[(eq_sal["csp_rel"] > 0)].copy()
ax_g.scatter(eq_csp["csp_rel"] * 100, eq_csp["Shannon"], s=14, alpha=0.45, c="#444",
             edgecolor="none", label=f"Empty Quarter (n={len(eq_csp)})")
# Namib
nam = cd_per[cd_per.desert == "Namib"].copy()
nam["csp_rel_85"] = pd.to_numeric(nam["csp_rel_85"], errors="coerce")
nam_plot = nam.dropna(subset=["csp_rel_85", "shannon_otu97"])
nam_plot = nam_plot[nam_plot["csp_rel_85"] > 0]
ax_g.scatter(nam_plot["csp_rel_85"] * 100, nam_plot["shannon_otu97"], s=40, alpha=0.85,
             c="#d97706", edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5, label=f"Namib (n={len(nam_plot)})")
# Per-desert regression lines
for xc, yc, col in [(eq_csp["csp_rel"]*100, eq_csp["Shannon"], "#444"),
                    (nam_plot["csp_rel_85"]*100, nam_plot["shannon_otu97"], "#d97706")]:
    if len(xc) > 5:
        log_x = np.log10(xc)
        lr = linregress(log_x, yc)
        xs = np.linspace(log_x.min(), log_x.max(), 50)
        ax_g.plot(10**xs, lr.intercept + lr.slope * xs, color=col, lw=1.6, ls="--", alpha=0.9)
# Stats
r_eq, p_eq = spearmanr(eq_csp["csp_rel"], eq_csp["Shannon"])
r_nm, p_nm = spearmanr(nam_plot["csp_rel_85"], nam_plot["shannon_otu97"])
ax_g.set_xscale("log")
ax_g.set_xlabel("CSP1-2 rel. abundance (%, log)")
ax_g.set_ylabel("Shannon")
ax_g.set_title("(e) CSP1-2 rel. abundance vs Shannon (EQ + Namib)\n" +
               fr"    EQ: ρ={r_eq:+.2f}, p={p_eq:.1e}  |  Namib: ρ={r_nm:+.2f}, p={p_nm:.1e}", loc="left", fontsize=9)
ax_g.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8, frameon=False)
ax_g.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax_g.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

# (h) Salinity → Shannon — EQ (XRF S, as % dry mass proxy) + Atacama (EC)
ax_h = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
# EQ: scatter using XRF S
eq_s = eq_sal[eq_sal["S"] > 0].copy()
ax_h.scatter(eq_s["S"], eq_s["Shannon"], s=16, alpha=0.45, c="#444",
             edgecolor="none", label=f"Empty Quarter (XRF S, n={len(eq_s)})")
# Atacama
atac = cd_per[cd_per.desert == "Atacama"].copy()
atac["ec"] = pd.to_numeric(atac["electrical_conductivity"], errors="coerce")
atac = atac.dropna(subset=["ec", "shannon_otu97"])
atac = atac[atac.ec > 0]
# EQ XRF S and Atacama EC are different units; use twin axes by normalising ranks
# Simpler: plot both on a common "salinity proxy (log, per-desert z-score)" axis
def zlog(x): return (np.log10(x) - np.log10(x).mean()) / np.log10(x).std()
ax_h.scatter(zlog(eq_s["S"]), eq_s["Shannon"], s=16, alpha=0.45, c="#444", edgecolor="none")
ax_h.scatter(zlog(atac["ec"]), atac["shannon_otu97"], s=40, alpha=0.85, c="#b91c1c",
             edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5, label=f"Atacama (EC, n={len(atac)})")
# Per-desert regression lines on z-scored log axes
for xc, yc, col in [(zlog(eq_s["S"]), eq_s["Shannon"], "#444"),
                    (zlog(atac["ec"]), atac["shannon_otu97"], "#b91c1c")]:
    if len(xc) > 5:
        lr = linregress(xc, yc)
        xs = np.linspace(xc.min(), xc.max(), 50)
        ax_h.plot(xs, lr.intercept + lr.slope * xs, color=col, lw=1.6, ls="--", alpha=0.9)
# Clear labels and re-draw Empty-Quarter scatter to match
# Replace ax_h labels (zlog x already done)
ax_h.cla()
ax_h.scatter(zlog(eq_s["S"]), eq_s["Shannon"], s=16, alpha=0.45, c="#444", edgecolor="none",
             label=f"Empty Quarter (XRF S, n={len(eq_s)})")
ax_h.scatter(zlog(atac["ec"]), atac["shannon_otu97"], s=40, alpha=0.85, c="#b91c1c",
             edgecolor="k", linewidth=0.5, label=f"Atacama (EC, n={len(atac)})")
for xc, yc, col in [(zlog(eq_s["S"]), eq_s["Shannon"], "#444"),
                    (zlog(atac["ec"]), atac["shannon_otu97"], "#b91c1c")]:
    if len(xc) > 5:
        lr = linregress(xc, yc)
        xs = np.linspace(xc.min(), xc.max(), 50)
        ax_h.plot(xs, lr.intercept + lr.slope * xs, color=col, lw=1.6, ls="--", alpha=0.9)
r_eq_s, p_eq_s = spearmanr(eq_s["S"], eq_s["Shannon"])
r_at, p_at = spearmanr(atac.ec, atac.shannon_otu97)
ax_h.set_xlabel("Salinity proxy (log, per-desert z-score)")
ax_h.set_ylabel("Shannon")
ax_h.set_title("(f) Salinity vs Shannon (EQ + Atacama)\n" +
               fr"    EQ (XRF S): ρ={r_eq_s:+.2f}, p={p_eq_s:.1e}  |  Atacama (EC): ρ={r_at:+.2f}, p={p_at:.1e}", loc="left", fontsize=9)
ax_h.legend(loc="lower left", fontsize=8, frameon=False)
ax_h.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax_h.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

out_pdf = FIG / "fig3_csp12.pdf"
fig.savefig(out_pdf, bbox_inches="tight")
fig.savefig(FIG / "fig3_csp12.png", bbox_inches="tight", dpi=160)
print(f"wrote {out_pdf} ({out_pdf.stat().st_size} bytes)")
plt.show()
```
